size.value: Paper applications: 35mm wide x 45mm high. Online applications: portrait orientation, 3:4 aspect ratio (no fixed print size).

background.value: Must be neutral and plain; only the applicant may be visible in the photo — no other people or objects in the background.

head_height.value: No fixed millimetre figure is given for online uploads; the face must cover between 70% and 80% of the image and be in the middle of the frame.

validity.value: Photo must be taken within the last 6 months

file_spec.value: Format: JPG or JPEG only. File size between 512KB and 3.14MB (professional studio photos may be up to 10MB). Photo must not be edited or altered — no filters, no beautification features, no AI editing tools, and not a photo of a photo.

expression_restriction.value: Look straight at the camera with a neutral expression and mouth closed; face must not be turned to the side or angled.

glasses_policy.value: Prescription glasses are permitted only if clear and not tinted (no sunglasses), without heavy frames that cover the face, and must not create glare or reflection.

ears_visibility.value: Ears must be visible unless a scarf is worn for religious or medical reasons; hair must not cover the face or ears.

face_visibility.value: Eyes open, mouth closed, neutral expression; face must cover 70-80% of the image and be centred, not turned or angled to the side.

headwear_policy.value: Head coverings are permitted only for religious or medical reasons, and the covering must not cover the mouth or the sides of the face.

expression.en: Look straight at the camera with a neutral expression and mouth closed; face must not be turned to the side or angled.
expression.ko: 카메라를 정면으로 응시하고 무표정을 유지하며 입은 다물 것; 얼굴을 옆으로 돌리거나 기울이지 말 것.
expression.ja: カメラを正面から見つめ、無表情で口を閉じること。顔を横に向けたり傾けたりしないこと。

glasses.en: Prescription glasses are permitted only if clear and not tinted (no sunglasses), without heavy frames that cover the face, and must not create glare or reflection.
glasses.ko: 도수 안경은 투명하고 색이 없는 경우(선글라스 불가)에만 허용되며, 얼굴을 가리는 두꺼운 테는 안 되고 빛 반사가 없어야 한다.
glasses.ja: 度付きメガネは透明で色がついていない場合(サングラス不可)のみ許可され、顔を覆う太いフレームは不可、光の反射がないこと。

ears.en: Ears must be visible unless a scarf is worn for religious or medical reasons; hair must not cover the face or ears.
ears.ko: 종교적·의료적 사유로 스카프를 착용하는 경우를 제외하고 귀가 보여야 하며, 머리카락이 얼굴이나 귀를 가리면 안 된다.
ears.ja: 宗教上または医療上の理由でスカーフを着用する場合を除き、耳が見える必要があり、髪の毛で顔や耳を覆ってはならない。

face_visibility.en: Eyes open, mouth closed, neutral expression; face must cover 70-80% of the image and be centred, not turned or angled to the side.
face_visibility.ko: 눈은 뜨고 입은 다물며 무표정을 유지할 것; 얼굴이 사진의 70~80%를 차지하며 중앙에 위치해야 하고 돌리거나 기울이면 안 된다.
face_visibility.ja: 目を開けて口を閉じ、無表情を保つこと。顔は写真の70~80%を占め中央に位置し、横に向けたり傾けたりしないこと。

headwear.en: Head coverings are permitted only for religious or medical reasons, and must not cover the mouth or the sides of the face.
headwear.ko: 머리 가리개(스카프 등)는 종교적·의료적 사유가 있을 때만 허용되며, 입이나 얼굴 양옆을 가리면 안 된다.
headwear.ja: 頭部の覆い(スカーフ等)は宗教上または医療上の理由がある場合のみ許可され、口や顔の両側を覆ってはならない。

cross_verification.note_en: Directly fetched from immigration.govt.nz (Immigration New Zealand's own 'Acceptable photos for a visa or NZeTA' page). Size (35x45mm for paper applications) matches the DB's 3.5x4.5cm exactly. Background is described only as 'neutral and plain' — this does not explicitly rule out white the way the separate New Zealand PASSPORT page does (see nz-passport.json, which explicitly says avoid white), so no background conflict is flagged here since white was not explicitly excluded on this visa-specific page.
